title: Application tray icon (Java Embedded Frame): No context menu, no mouse actions
line: Tray icons of Java apps like MinimServer and JDownloader respond to clicks again and open their context menus.
explanation: Since b0f3f954 the proxy picks direct event injection when the embedded window or any descendant selects button presses, which is the case for Java's JavaEmbeddedFrame: the frame itself does not, but its content window and icon canvas do. The direct click was still sent only to the embedded frame with propagation off, so no client received it and the icon ignored every click. The change sends direct clicks to the window a real click would reach: the deepest viewable window under the click point, or its closest ancestor that selected button presses, with coordinates translated to it.

commits.message:
xembed-sni-proxy: send direct clicks to the window that wants them

Java tray icons only select button events on a child of the embedded
window, so clicks sent straight to the embedded window were dropped and
nothing happened. Send them where a real click would end up instead.

BUG: 498824

media.caption: Right click on the Java TrayIconDemo icon: nothing opens
Right click on the Java icon opens its menu
Double click on the Java icon: no action
Double click runs the icon's action (its dialog opens)
